When concurrent reservations attempt to lock both inventory seats and customer loyalty balances simultaneously, transactions acquire resource locks in arbitrary sequence, which causes circular wait deadlocks across 60 worker instances, instructing the engineer to sort resource identifiers lexicographically before acquiring locks instead.
